verification.method: scripts/verify/italy.py reads the original UN files directly (not the site's generated data) and compares them with the built page, JSON-LD and CSV; the build itself fails if any sentence-level claim (assertClaim) stops being true; then a hand read of title, description, headline, FAQ and story text.
what: Population 1950–2100, rank 2026/2100, share, growth, daily fall, density, land area

Births over 1 million in 1964 and now (thousands), deaths; fertility 1964/2026, second-lowest in Europe (over 5 million) after Ukraine
Median age 1950/2026/2050, highest among European countries over 5 million and second to Japan worldwide in that group; life expectancy 1950/2026
2100 total, 40.0% fall, sixth-steepest among countries over 20 million; largest population in Southern Europe; urban share; title, meta description, headline, FAQ JSON-LD, CSV rows, live counter
against: UN WPP 2024 original file WPP2024_Demographic_Indicators_Medium.csv.gz (SHA-256 286ac36b…, downloaded 2026-11-25) and interim update zip (eb7846bf…) — 68 of 68 checks match

verification.result: All figures match. Statements about Europe are limited to countries over 5 or 10 million because some microstates rank higher. No image alt text on the page (the flag and charts carry aria-labels).
